environment.isolation: Docker container in a Linux virtual machine on a shared macOS ARM64 desktop host. Load on the macOS host outside the virtual machine was not recorded. No exclusive-host or thermal-control claim.

profile.diagnostics: non-clearing native loss/retransmission before and after timing; OS resource deltas
profile.payload: all received bytes verified; Live sequence and boundaries checked
profile.offered_load: unpaced, native nonblocking backpressure; no application rate cap

controls.statistic: paired geometric mean ratios; 10000 paired bootstrap draws, percentile 95% CI; no exclusions
controls.scope: Provisional measured profile only, not deployment qualification; CPU seconds are not hardware cycles

recaptured: First capture discarded: containers of an unrelated workload ran in the same virtual machine during it. This is the second capture, taken with no other container running.

capture_load.note: One-minute load average of the Linux virtual machine sampled every 10 s during this case; added after capture. Includes the benchmark itself.
